name: free-ai-studio
description: Chat with your FreeLLMAPI router from VS Code. Uses the desktop app when it is running and starts a built-in local server when it is not.

commands.title: Sarthi Studio: Ask about the selection
Sarthi Studio: Attach the active file
Sarthi Studio: Set router API key
Sarthi Studio: Restart the built-in server
Sarthi Studio: Open the desktop app

freeAiStudio.desktopUrl.description: Loopback address of a running Sarthi Studio desktop app.

freeAiStudio.routerBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your router (FreeLLMAPI by default).

freeAiStudio.model.description: Model the built-in server requests. `auto` lets the router choose and fall back.

freeAiStudio.contextBudgetTokens.description: Hard token budget for each request sent by the built-in server.

freeAiStudio.historyMessages.description: How many recent messages compete for the token budget.

enumDescriptions: Send no reasoning parameter; the model's own default applies.
No reasoning parameter is sent (an explicit off).
A short reasoning pass - fastest, cheapest.
A deeper reasoning pass - slowest, most tokens.
freeAiStudio.thinkingLevel.description: Reasoning level the built-in server asks for on chat turns. A message's Think choice or @Thinking directive wins over this setting.
